composition_subtypes.role: evaluate candidate products of first i and last 5-i elements

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort array, then try all combinations of smallest i and largest 5-i numbers to find max product.
payload.rationale: Solution uses sorting to arrange elements in non-decreasing order, then greedily checks only boundary combinations (0-5 smallest, rest largest) as the optimal product must be among these due to multiplication sign properties.
